'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Matthew Sokol LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol|Matthew Sokol]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Coffee over-easy.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' Mr. Purple
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
